description: Builds a prefilled North Cyprus car-rental booking URL (https://www.kiprarent.com/book/cars) for the given dates. The visitor picks a car and confirms — no credit card, no deposit, free cancellation. Use language "tr" or "en" to match the visitor.

currency.description: Optional price display currency for the booking engine.

pickup_at.description: Pickup date-time 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', Cyprus local time, within the booking hours.

return_at.description: Return date-time 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', after pickup_at, within the booking hours.

name: get_booking_link
title: Get a prefilled booking URL
